text.tspan: Traditional faculty workflow
Sanchay
The record is rebuilt from memory, once a year
The record is already there when the form arrives
A professor teaches, publishes, mentors, reviews,
attends an FDP
Nine months pass. Nothing records any of it.
Appraisal season opens
Reconstruct twelve months from memory
Hunt Gmail, Drive and folders for certificates
Re-type all of it into this year's form
Next form, next format: start again
A professor teaches, publishes, mentors, reviews,
attends an FDP
Signals are captured as the work happens
Each signal is structured; evidence stays attached
One academic record keeps growing
The professor confirms, edits or ignores proposals
Appraisal, forms, reports and career plans read that
record
Next form: the answers are already known
The professor is the database
The system is the database
